maria: Heads-up: seeing a spike of 502s hitting hosted-api in us-east-1 around 10:12-10:25 UTC. Most from embeddings route. :eyes:
sam-sre: Repro? any trace_id examples?
maria: yes, sample trace: trace=abc1234. Envoy logs show "upstream reset before headers". Pasting snippet:
```
[envoy] 2026-03-17T10:13:05Z upstream reset: reset reason=connection_failure remote_addr=10.2.3.4:443
```
lee-support: Customer escalation incoming — 3 tenants reported timeouts + 502s. @oncall-bot can you confirm any deploys?
oncall-bot: No deploys in the window. Autoscaler events: scaled dedicated pools up 2x at 10:11:50 due to CPU spike.
sam-sre: Could be midproxy connpool exhaustion. Check auth proxy error rates and keepalives. Maria, can you grep for `h2 connection errors` on the ingress boxes?
maria: Done. Found repeated `stream reset` with `RST_STREAM 2` and a pattern of idle window exhaustion. Example:
`http2: GOAWAY last_stream_id=215 debug=...`
devops-bot: Noted spike in 4xx from auth service at 10:10, correlates with token rotation job.
lee-support: Customer says failures started right after they rotated JWTs. Could be header size or malformed auth causing upstream to reject.
maria: I ran quick curl repro (from support box) that reproduces 502 when passing rotated token header:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings"
> HTTP/2 502
< server: envoy
< x-request-id: trace=abc1234
< via: 1.1 edge
```
sam-sre: Can we confirm whether edge is marking upstream 503/502 vs resetting? Check envoy cluster health and socket metrics: `envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx` and `envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_destroy` spikes?
maria: Yes: envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_destroy +120 between 10:10-10:15, envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_5xx +40. I collected pcap on one box. Uploading location: s3://redwood-triage/pcap/1832109876-us-east1.pcap
lee-support: For mitigation, should we add a short-serving fallback behavior for embedding route to a lower-tier model to avoid customer impact?
sam-sre: Quick temp mitigation: increase keepalive pool size on edge from 100 -> 300 and lower idle timeout from 300s -> 60s to avoid stale connections. Patching config now.
maria: Patch applied on one shard, seeing immediate drop in cx_destroy, 502s down ~70% for that shard. Need roll to remaining shards.
devops-bot: Rolling config to 5 remaining shards: rolling update started.
lee-support: Also open a postmortem with customer-facing notes: what happened, repro steps, mitigation, and next steps (fix auth rotation handshake, improve health checks).
maria: Logs show auth service returned 401 for some tokens, which downstream treated as immediate connection close — investigating.
sam-sre: Root cause hypothesis: token rotation created a short window where auth-cache TTL was stale causing auth service to spike 5xx and then upstream reset. Action items: (1) add backoff on edge when upstream returns 5xx, (2) improve token-rollover handshake, (3) add test in CI that simulates rotation.
lee-support: I'll draft customer message and post initial RCA once we have full logs and config diffs.
maria: attaching quick grep output and config diff paths: /var/log/edge/envoy.log.gz, /etc/envoy/conf.d/keepalive.json.patch
oncall-bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026-1832 created. Ping @sam-sre for follow-ups.
sam-sre: Good. Follow-up: we should throttle embedding batch sizes temporarily — customers with massive batch embeddings cause long-lived streams that stress the pool.
lee-support: Noted. I'll contact the affected tenants with suggested workaround: reduce batch size and retry after 30s.
maria: will upload full traces + flamegraphs to the ticket.
sam-sre: once roll completes, monitor `5xx_rate` and `cx_destroy` for 1h, then close.
lee-support: thanks all. :thumbsup:
maria: closing loop after roll complete.
